item.title: backlog populate --preview mode — show AI-generated items before committing
item.intent: Users must be able to preview what backlog populate will add before it modifies backlog.json, so AI-generated noise cannot silently pollute the backlog.
item.description: cmd_backlog_populate runs the AI agent and writes items directly to backlog.json with no preview step. A --preview flag should run the agent, print proposed items in a readable format, and exit without writing.
steps: Add --preview flag to cmd_backlog_populate() via parse_opts
When --preview is active, run agent but capture output to temp file instead of writing to backlog.json
Print proposed items in same table format as backlog list (id, priority, title)
Exit 0 after preview without modifying backlog.json
Add --preview to usage message and help output
Run shellcheck — confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: Running backlog populate --preview prints proposed items and exits without modifying backlog.json
Running backlog populate without --preview still writes to backlog.json as before
Preview output includes id, priority, and title for each proposed item
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
